login.title: Sign in to Huly
login.subtitle: Enter your email and password
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
login.biometricFailed: Biometric unlock failed. Please sign in with your password.
login.biometricLockout: Biometrics are temporarily locked. Please sign in with your password.
login.biometricUnavailable: Biometric authentication is not available on this device.
login.failureMessage: Login failed. Please check your credentials and try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email associated with your account. We'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for that email, a password reset link has been sent. The link expires in 1 hour.
forgotPassword.networkError: Could not send reset link. Check your connection and try again.

recovery.title: Set a new password
recovery.subtitle: Choose a new password for your Huly account.
recovery.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
recovery.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
recovery.missingToken: This reset link is missing a token. Please request a new one.
recovery.failureMessage: The reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new reset email.

signUp.title: Create your Huly account
signUp.subtitle: We'll send a one-time verification code to your email.
signUp.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.duplicateEmail: An account with that email already exists.
signUp.missingName: Enter your first and last name.
signUp.failureMessage: Could not create your account. Please try again.

otp.title: Sign in with OTP
otp.subtitleEmail: Enter your email to receive a verification code
otp.requestFailed: Failed to send verification code. Please try again.
otp.validateFailed: Invalid verification code. Please try again.
otp.emailUnconfirmedMessage: Please confirm your email before signing in.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.failureMessage: Invalid verification code. Please try again.

biometric.enablePromptMessage: Skip entering your password next time you open Huly.
biometric.unavailable: Biometric authentication is not available on this device.
biometric.notEnrolled: No biometrics are enrolled on this device. Add one in Settings to enable biometric unlock.
biometric.lockout: Biometrics are temporarily locked. Please sign in with your password.

account.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to sign out of Huly?
